prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding tips and a timer to waiting screens was helpful (+8.9%, p=0.0008), closely matching predictions (+8.0%).
Redesigning path choice screens (split view) and intro/welcome screen layouts (story scroll, split view redesign) was helpful.
Certain new flows and preview screens were harmful, such as a post-setup launcher flow (-19.6%) and customization style preview screen (-9.1%).
Copy changes, step reordering, hints, and other waiting screen changes showed no clear effect.
Predictions for path choice and layout redesign improvements were too low.
Predictions for new flows, new screens, step reordering, hints, and copy changes were consistently too high.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +5.9% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: -7.0% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +2.6% over 3 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -0.9% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +4.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +4.6% over 2 test(s)
- finish, hint: +8.9% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -6.4% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -2.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +12.8% over 1 test(s)
- home, redesign: +2.1% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.4% over 5 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: -0.2% over 4 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.9% over 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 86.5%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 69.5%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Mascot Welcome Celebration Screen: Insert a dedicated milestone screen right after waiting completes to celebrate pet creation before entering home intro. (why: The finish step drops off to 69.5% with a very long mean time of 5815s. A clear celebratory transition helps signal completion and drive momentum.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Photo Upload Step Flow: Enhance the upload photos screen with an interactive photo picker component and mascot instructions for optimal pet rendering. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted custom pet creation failures or incorrect appearance, contributing to the 60.9% adoption drop-off.)
2: [adoption, layout] Two Column Adoption Certificate Layout: Switch the adoption certificate screen layout to two-column to display certificate details alongside an animated mascot preview. (why: Adoption is the lowest performing funnel step (60.9%). Restructuring visual components improves presentation clarity.)
3: [home, wait_info] Interactive Tip Carousel Waiting Screen Component: Add an interactive tip carousel component on the waiting screen to engage users while waiting for background pet generation. (why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s. Previous data showed timer and tip additions increased conversion by +8.9%.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Sign-In Mascot Persistence Hint: Display an account sync benefit hint and cloud status badge on the sign-in screen. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets when re-logging in. Explicitly stating account persistence alleviates user concern.)
5: [finish, incentive] Desktop Mascot Controls Interactive Checklist: Add an interactive task checklist component to the home intro screen detailing primary pet interactions. (why: Support tickets show user confusion after setup regarding controlling, hiding, and talking to their mascot.)

scores.note: New screens at finish step previously degraded conversion (-2.6%).
Targeted drop-off and support tickets, but new flows carry risk.
Adoption step drops most users; layout redesigns consistently perform well.
Tips on waiting screens have strong historical validation (+8.9%).
Strong evidence from support emails, but hints and copy tweaks show negligible lift.
Addresses post-setup confusion mentioned in support tickets with moderate implementation cost.
